title: Probe answers of a run (.a2dlc/run/<slice>/answers.json, written by a2dlc answer)
description: A person's choices for the probes of a run (multiple-choice, spec_divergence and pi_S relaxations). Written only by the CLI command a2dlc answer, never by a role: the file lives under .a2dlc/run/, which the builders cannot edit. Bound to the run and to the contract it was asked about: contract_hash is the sha256 of S* when the probe was asked, or the sha256 of escalations.json for a Stage 1 divergence (there is no S* yet), and an answer whose hash does not match the current S* is not applied. The resume path reads it in Stage 1 and Stage 1.5 only.

choice.description: The option chosen among the probe's options.

by.description: Who answered: the name the operator gave. Recorded, not authenticated.
